The software shall detect watchdog reset and log occurrence
The software shall persist mission data to non-volatile memory

The software shall detect and handle corrupted data

The software shall sample sensors at configurable rates
The software shall validate sensor readings against limits
The software shall include telemetry in beacon transmissions

The software shall enable the FM transponder only while transmission is permitted, the radio is powered, the ground allows it, the mode is ACTIVE, the array is sunlit, the SOC is at least 55 %, the PA is below 70 °C (resuming at 60 °C) and the keyed time is under 25 % of the last 100 minutes

The software shall drive the transponder enable XPDR_EN as a heartbeat renewed by every main-loop pass while the transponder gates hold, with a lease of at most 60 ms, so that the radio board's 50 ms monostable drops the transponder within 110 ms of the last pass; a level on the pin shall not enable it

The software shall hold the mode at IDLE, the payload and the transponder off from ARM_FLIGHT until an authenticated commissioning release telecommand, across resets, and shall hold after an unreadable operations record
The software shall let the ground stop and allow the transponder by telecommand, persisted across resets, without changing its other gates

The software shall power the GNSS receiver for sessions, every orbit in launch and early operations then four a day, keep the latest fix with its time and quality, and start a session on command; a session shall run only with the Jetson off and the SOC at least 40 %, and shall hold the transponder off

The software shall downlink a housekeeping frame every fifth beacon and on command, carrying temperatures, battery current and voltage, array power, deployment, RF-silence, boot and reset, fault-log head, body rates, contact timeout and GNSS fix age, through the downlink's inhibits and duty limit
The software shall command no magnetorquer output until 120 s after separation (SpaceX Rideshare User's Guide v11 §3.3.4)
The software shall latch the served 45-minute RF silence, so that a sense line reading stowed afterwards does not restart it
The software shall space deployment attempts 50 minutes apart and accept a telecommand to retry an element with fresh attempts once the 30-minute wait is served

The software shall deploy the solar wings first, each wing burning its two resistors on separate drivers in turn, and then the antennas through the bought AntS controller over I2C (arm, deploy, cancel, disarm), reading each antenna element's deployment switch from the AntS status and reporting the deployed elements in housekeeping
The software shall use a magnetometer sample only when the magnetorquers have been off for at least 50 ms, discard and count any other sample, and log the first discarded sample after init as a fault

The software shall command each magnetorquer burst for 900 ms of the 1 s control period, with the dipole scaled by the period over the on-time and saturated at 0.2 A·m², so the delivered impulse is the control law's
The software shall not complete a detumble on a magnetometer rate estimate that a discarded sample left stale

The software shall run B-dot detumble (gain 10⁴ A·m²·s/T) and spin-stabilized sun pointing of +Y at 8°/s (momentum gain 0.005 s⁻¹, spin hold 0.005 s⁻¹, nutation damping 3·10⁻⁴ N·m·s with the gyro and 1·10⁻⁴ N·m·s without it) at 1 Hz, and treat a detumble lasting over 285 minutes as a fault

The software shall let the ground select, by authenticated telecommand persisted across resets, the spin axis and inertia tensor from the presets for both wings, wing 1 only, wing 2 only and no wings deployed, and shall refuse any other preset
The software shall select the beacon template, propose the transponder bucket and propose the power-mode preference with the OBC selector of SQSO-PAY-SEL-001, or abstain to the fixed rules
The selector shall choose only among the pre-approved templates, and every value in a beacon shall come from measurements
The selector's proposals shall only restrict the transponder gates and the mode manager, never extend them
The flight inference shall reproduce the trained model bit for bit on the shared test vectors
The combined decision shall never be less conservative than the fixed rules, for any inputs and any valid model table
A head shall abstain when a feature is stale, missing or outside its training range, or the calibrated confidence is below its threshold
A model table that fails its CRC, version or schema check shall disable the selector for the boot and be logged, and parsing any table shall be bounded and free of panics
A selector decision shall take at most 0.2 ms and 10 µJ on the STM32L4R5, and the mission simulation with the selector shall show no check worse than with the fixed rules
The main control loop shall execute within 20 ms
Beacon transmission shall complete within 5 seconds

The software shall select the downlink power at the commanded level (0.5 W or 1 W, never above 1 W)

The software shall monitor the transmitter's temperature, forward and reflected power while keyed: VSWR above 3:1 on 3 samples in a row caps the power at 0.5 W, and at 0.5 W stops the downlink for 10 minutes; above 70 °C (TBR-SRS-003) nothing is sent until below 60 °C; a keyed frame without forward power is reported
The software shall operate continuously for minimum 1 year

The software shall support both simulation and flight builds
